props.name: value
props.description: Selected date as an ISO yyyy-mm-dd string.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Pair with a Field for a visible label.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field is empty.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as failing validation. Pair it with a message.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: id
props.description: Overrides the generated id. Useful when a label lives elsewhere.
